tournament.name: MTG China Open S8 Regional Championship - Dragon Shield Cup

decks.notes: The deck focuses on utilizing Underworld Breach along with Emry, Lurker of the Loch and Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student to create a powerful combo that allows for repetitive casting of spells from the graveyard. By milling cards with Grinding Station and using Mishra's Bauble and Mox Opal for mana acceleration, the deck aims to quickly assemble the combo pieces and win the game through either milling the opponent out with Thassa's Oracle or dealing direct damage with Malevolent Rumble. The inclusion of Urza's Saga provides additional utility and consistency to the deck.

This aggro deck focuses on disrupting opponents' resources and board state while applying pressure with efficient creatures. Using cards like Thoughtseize and Fatal Push to control the game, along with powerful creatures like Overlord of the Balemurk and Ketramose, the New Dawn, the deck aims to win quickly and decisively. By combining disruptive elements with aggressive threats, the deck can quickly overwhelm opponents and secure victory. Additionally, the inclusion of Ephemerate and other flicker effects provides additional value and flexibility in key moments.

The deck aims to quickly fill the graveyard with artifacts using cards like Mishra's Bauble and Mox Opal, then utilize Underworld Breach to cast spells from the graveyard for a powerful combo finish. Emry, Lurker of the Loch and Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student help with card selection and recursion, while Urza's Saga provides additional artifact support. The deck also includes disruption in the form of Lightning Bolt and Swan Song to protect the combo. Overall, the deck focuses on assembling the combo pieces quickly and efficiently to overwhelm the opponent.

The deck focuses on using Emry, Lurker of the Loch and Underworld Breach to continuously loop through cards in graveyard, creating a combo engine that can quickly mill the opponent's library or win through alternate win conditions like Thassa's Oracle. The deck includes various artifacts and spell cards that synergize with the combo pieces, providing control elements and protection. It aims to assemble the combo pieces quickly and efficiently to overwhelm the opponent and achieve victory.

The deck revolves around using Emry, Lurker of the Loch to continually recur artifacts from the graveyard, while also utilizing Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student to dig for combo pieces. The main win condition is to assemble the combo of Grinding Station, Mishra's Bauble, and Underworld Breach to loop cards infinitely and mill the opponent out. The deck also has control elements such as Urza's Saga and Malevolent Rumble to disrupt the opponent's game plan. The key strategy is to quickly assemble the combo pieces and disrupt the opponent's game plan to secure a win.

The deck focuses on utilizing Underworld Breach to repeatedly cast spells from the graveyard, combining cards like Emry, Lurker of the Loch and Grinding Station to create a powerful combo that can mill the opponent's deck or find ways to win the game through Thassa's Oracle. The deck also includes disruptive elements like Spell Pierce and Spell Snare to control the opponent's plays while generating mana with Mox Opal and Mox Amber. With the right setup, the deck can quickly overwhelm the opponent and achieve victory through its carefully crafted interactions.

The main strategy of this UW Control deck is to control the game through countering spells, removal, and card advantage. It aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan using cards like Counterspell, Prismatic Ending, and Narset, Parter of Veils, while also generating card advantage with Teferi, Hero of Dominaria and Lórien Revealed. The deck also has a touch of creature removal with cards like Solitude and Wrath of the Skies. The mana base is fine-tuned to provide the necessary colors for casting spells efficiently.

The deck revolves around using a variety of creatures to create a toolbox of options for different situations. By combining creatures with various abilities like sacrifice, recursion, and tutoring, the deck aims to create powerful synergies and combos to outpace and outmaneuver opponents. The deck utilizes cards like Yawgmoth, Thran Physician and Agatha's Soul Cauldron to generate value and fuel its engine, with cards like Chord of Calling and Green Sun's Zenith to find the right creature for any given situation. The deck also includes cards like Walking Ballista and Grist, the Hunger Tide for additional win conditions.

The deck focuses on utilizing a mix of powerful creatures and spells to quickly overwhelm the opponent with aggression. By playing efficient creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Scion of Draco, along with removal spells like Lightning Bolt and Tribal Flames, the deck aims to control the battlefield and deal damage quickly. The Leyline cards and Leyline Binding provide additional support by boosting the deck's synergy and consistency. The inclusion of dual lands and fetch lands ensures the deck has the necessary mana base to consistently cast its spells.

The deck focuses on utilizing the Underworld Breach combo to continuously loop through cards in the graveyard, enabling powerful plays with Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student and Grinding Station. Emry, Lurker of the Loch and Mishra's Bauble provide additional value and card draw. The deck includes a variety of artifact and instant spells to control the board and disrupt the opponent's strategy. The goal is to set up a win condition with Thassa's Oracle or deal direct damage with Malevolent Rumble. The land base includes various fetchlands to ensure color consistency.

The main focus of this deck is to utilize the Underworld Breach combo to continuously loop cards from the graveyard in order to mill the opponent's library. Emry, Lurker of the Loch and Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student help to dig for key pieces, while Grinding Station and Mishra's Bauble provide additional support for the combo. This deck also includes disruptive elements like Spell Pierce and Lightning Bolt to control the board and protect the combo. By efficiently cycling through the deck and utilizing the graveyard, this deck aims to quickly win through milling the opponent.

This deck focuses on utilizing powerful combo pieces to win without the need for traditional lands. By carefully managing resources and leveraging key cards like Hydroelectric Specimen and Goblin Charbelcher, the deck aims to quickly establish a dominating board state and overwhelm opponents. With a mix of control elements and card draw, the deck can disrupt enemy strategies while setting up its own win conditions efficiently. The use of efficient creature removal and countermagic ensures that the deck can handle a variety of opposing threats and maintain consistency in executing its game plan.

This deck focuses on quickly building a board presence of Merfolk creatures with the help of Lords of Atlantis and Master of the Pearl Trident to boost each other's power and toughness. The deck aims to disrupt the opponent's strategy with cards like Tide Shaper and Tishana's Tidebinder while also using Aether Vial to cheat creatures into play. The deck has some counter spells like Flare of Denial and Force of Negation for added protection. With a mix of aggressive creatures and disruptive spells, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent and secure a quick victory.

The deck focuses on utilizing blink effects to continuously trigger powerful enter the battlefield abilities of creatures, while also disrupting the opponent's game plan with removal and hand disruption spells. By flickering creatures like Ketramose, the New Dawn and Overlord of the Balemurk, the deck can generate value and board presence quickly. The combination of aggro creatures and blink effects allows for aggressive plays while also maintaining card advantage through repeatable ETB triggers. The deck also includes a mix of removal and disruption spells to control the game tempo and outpace the opponent.

The deck focuses on aggressive creatures that can blink in and out of play to disrupt the opponent's strategy. By utilizing cards like Ephemerate and Flickerwisp, the deck can repeatedly trigger powerful abilities such as protection, card draw, or sacrifice effects. The deck also includes disruption spells like Thoughtseize and Fatal Push to disrupt the opponent's game plan. With a mix of aggressive creatures with blinking abilities and disruption spells, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent and control the battlefield.

The deck focuses on utilizing mill cards such as Hedron Crab, Ruin Crab, Fractured Sanity, and Glimpse the Unthinkable along with disruption spells like Archive Trap, Surgical Extraction, and Thought Scour to quickly mill the opponent's deck and win the game through decking them out. The deck also includes some removal and counter spells like Fatal Push, Drown in the Loch, and Jace, the Perfected Mind to control the board and protect the combo. The mana base includes fetch lands and utility lands to ensure consistent mana production and deck thinning.

The key concept of this deck is to quickly assemble the Allosaurus Combo by using cards like Neoform and Eldritch Evolution to cheat out powerful creatures like Chancellor of the Tangle and Atraxa, Grand Unifier. These creatures generate mana and allow for explosive plays to be made, culminating in casting large threats like Ghalta, Stampede Tyrant and Koma, World-Eater. The deck also includes disruption in the form of cards like Force of Vigor and Solitude to protect the combo. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with a powerful board state and win the game quickly.

This Boros Aggro deck focuses on quickly overwhelming the opponent with a mix of aggressive creatures and burn spells. The key strategy is to establish early board presence with creatures like Ocelot Pride and Guide of Souls, supported by removal spells like Galvanic Discharge. Ajani, Nacatl Pariah can help buff your creatures and push for lethal damage. Static Prison can slow down the opponent's game plan, while cards like Ranger-Captain of Eos and Goblin Bombardment provide additional utility and reach. With a solid mana base and versatile spells, this deck aims to win the game through relentless aggression and efficient removal.

This Boros Aggro deck focuses on overwhelming the opponent with aggressive creatures and burn spells. The key strategy is to quickly establish a board presence with efficient creatures like Guide of Souls and Seasoned Pyromancer, while also using burn spells like Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury and Galvanic Discharge to deal direct damage to the opponent's life total. The deck also includes disruption elements like Ranger-Captain of Eos and Static Prison to control the board. Overall, the goal is to close out the game quickly by applying pressure and finishing off the opponent with direct damage.

This deck focuses on utilizing Underworld Breach to continuously recast cards from the graveyard, generating value and setting up a combo win condition. Cards like Emry, Lurker of the Loch and Grinding Station help fuel the graveyard while Mishra's Bauble and Mox Opal provide additional resources. Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student helps dig for combo pieces, with support from cards like Thassa's Oracle and Aether Spellbomb. The deck also includes disruption in the form of Lightning Bolt, Spell Pierce, and Spell Snare to control the opponent's game plan while setting up its own win.

The deck focuses on assembling the combo pieces of Emry, Lurker of the Loch and Grinding Station to create a loop that allows for repeated milling of the opponent's deck. Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student and Underworld Breach serve as additional ways to dig for key cards and bring them back from the graveyard. The deck also includes various control elements such as counterspells and removal to protect the combo and disrupt the opponent. Urza's Saga provides additional utility and flexibility in finding necessary artifacts for the combo.

The main concept of this deck is to utilize Underworld Breach alongside various artifacts and spells to create a powerful combo engine. Emry, Lurker of the Loch and Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student help to fuel the graveyard with artifacts, while spells like Malevolent Rumble and Stock Up can be recast multiple times with Underworld Breach. This deck aims to quickly cycle through the library, generate mana with Mox Opal and Mox Amber, and ultimately win the game through a combination of Grinding Station, Thassa's Oracle, or Jace, Wielder of Mysteries.

The core strategy of this deck revolves around utilizing the Underworld Breach card to repeatedly cast powerful spells from the graveyard, while also taking advantage of artifacts and card draw engines like Emry, Lurker of the Loch and Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student. The goal is to assemble a combination of cards that will allow you to quickly win the game, whether through milling your opponent's library with Grinding Station or setting up a Thassa's Oracle win condition. The deck also includes disruption and removal spells to protect its combo pieces and disrupt the opponent's game plan.

The deck focuses on using aggressive creatures like Death's Shadow, Nethergoyf, and Mockingbird to deal damage quickly to the opponent. It also utilizes cards like Mishra's Bauble, Fatal Push, and Stubborn Denial to control the board and disrupt the opponent's strategy. Thoughtseize and Dress Down help with hand disruption and managing threats on the battlefield. The deck runs a low land count with a mix of fetch lands and shock lands to efficiently play its spells and creatures.

The deck focuses on ramping up mana quickly to bring out powerful Eldrazi creatures and control the game with disruption spells. By using cards like Talisman of Impulse and Utopia Sprawl, it accelerates mana production to cast big threats like Emrakul, the Promised End and World Breaker. The deck also includes control spells like Kozilek's Return and Malevolent Rumble to deal with opponent's threats. Karn, the Great Creator provides additional utility and disruption. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with massive creatures and disruption spells while controlling the board.

The deck focuses on ramping up mana quickly to cast powerful Eldrazi creatures and control the game with powerful spells and abilities. It combines ramp cards like Utopia Sprawl and Eldrazi Temple with control elements like Kozilek's Command and Malevolent Rumble to disrupt the opponent's game plan while building towards casting Emrakul, the Promised End and other Eldrazi threats. Karn, the Great Creator provides additional utility and the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with massive creatures and disruptive spells before they can establish their own game plan.

This deck aims to control the game and ramp up mana to play powerful Eldrazi creatures. Cards like Sowing Mycospawn and Malevolent Rumble help control the board while Talisman of Impulse and Utopia Sprawl accelerate mana production. Emrakul, the Promised End and World Breaker are key threats that can quickly turn the tide of the game. Karn, the Great Creator provides utility and access to artifacts, adding another layer of control. The deck utilizes a mix of creature threats, removal spells, and ramp to disrupt the opponent's game plan and dominate the late game.

The main concept of this deck is to control the opponent's actions through a combination of disruption, removal, and card advantage. The deck focuses on using counterspells, removal spells like Fatal Push and Prismatic Ending, and graveyard hate like Relic of Progenitus. In addition, the deck utilizes creatures like Ketramose, the New Dawn, Abhorrent Oculus, Subtlety, and Psychic Frog to provide additional control and threats on the board. The land base is optimized for fixing mana and fetching key lands when needed. Overall, the deck aims to outvalue the opponent and maintain control of the game.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly deploy aggressive creatures and use various burn spells to control the board and deal direct damage to the opponent. The deck includes a mix of creatures with varying abilities and power levels, along with a selection of burn spells and support cards to enhance the aggro strategy. The deck also includes some control elements, such as Static Prison, to disrupt the opponent's game plan. Additionally, the mana base is designed to support the deck's color requirements and ensure consistent performance.

This deck focuses on utilizing aggressive creatures and cards that can temporarily remove threats from the battlefield (blink) to gain an advantage. By using cards like Ephemerate and Flickerwisp, along with creatures like Ketramose and Overlord of the Balemurk, the deck can control the board and overwhelm opponents quickly. Additionally, the inclusion of graveyard hate like Relic of Progenitus and disruption like Thoughtseize helps to disrupt the opponent's game plan while the aggressive creatures deal damage. The deck aims to win the game before the opponent can stabilize.

The deck focuses on aggressive creatures that can be repeatedly blinked or returned to the battlefield for additional value. By utilizing cards like Ephemerate and Flickerwisp to blink creatures like Boggart Trawler and Emperor of Bones, as well as Overlord of the Balemurk and Phelia, Exuberant Shepherd, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with constant threats. The deck also includes disruption with cards like Fatal Push and Prismatic Ending, as well as graveyard hate with Relic of Progenitus. The mana base allows for consistent casting of both white and black spells.

This deck focuses on combining aggressive creatures with cards that allow them to temporarily leave and re-enter the battlefield, utilizing the "blink" mechanic. By blinking creatures like Ketramose, the New Dawn and Overlord of the Balemurk with cards like Flickerwisp and Ephemerate, players can trigger powerful abilities multiple times and disrupt their opponent's strategy. Alongside disruptive spells like Fatal Push and Thoughtseize, this deck aims to overwhelm opponents with a combination of fast, powerful creatures and strategic disruption.
